description: Make a codeitso cart link (https://codeitso.yoorrard.workers.dev/cart#s=…) from chosen material ids, optionally with a chosen AI model per AI API provider. Opening it puts the materials in the person's cart on the website, with previews, licenses, install commands and a prompt builder. Ids are not looked up; unknown ones show as missing there.

items.description: Materials in order: id from other codeitso tools, optional model id for AI API providers.

response_format.description: 'json' for structured output; default compact markdown.

name: codeitso_make_cart_link
title: 코드잇소 장바구니 링크 만들기
